faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi), a premier institute offering opportunities for research professionals on project-based assignments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The open position announced under advertisement number IITD/IRD/263/2026 is Research Assistant, aimed at supporting specialized research and development tasks within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant position under this specific project recruitment notification released by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BE or B.Tech degree in Computer Science or Information Technology, along with hands-on experience in Python programming and Data Annotation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 32,500/-, structured as per the guidelines of the funding project.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The final date to submit your duly filled application via email to the designated authority is 21 October 2026. Ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q7. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via Email. Candidates need to download Form No. IRD/REC-4 and email it with required details to the official contact.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application along with supporting documents should be emailed to Prof. Mohit Garg at the official email address: [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by an online interview for shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official website and notification?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification details and updates through the official IIT Delhi IRD recruitment website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
